attributes.board_name: Alabama State Board of Veterinary Medical Examiners

rules.accepted_credit_types: Board-approved scientific programs (min. 6 h); all 8 h may be RACE-approved online courses; in person, the other 2 h may be verifiable audio/video/journal/computer review or 1 h for state or local association meetings
rules.new_licensee_rule: New graduates do not have to comply until the next full calendar year after licensure.
rules.alternatives: Extensions for sickness or other justifiable reasons on written request before renewal; Board may exempt in exceptional circumstances.
rules.notes: Hours are counted January to December. Technicians certify hours yearly on a Board form and keep proof of attendance.
rules.rule_quote: (a) The applicant must verify yearly that he or she has finished at least eight hours of continuing education during the preceding year.
